d:
The first of our short stories is here, starting with an obligatory beach episode!

Fighting against Empires, Pirates, and Criminals offers no short amount of thrills in the galaxy, but sometimes Astra simply wishes to kick back in the sand and enjoy an ice cold drink!

What she may not have expected was for a certain Oogari tourist to take note of her troubles in the tropical heat, and offer her a tentacle!
